qualitative_hypothesis.causal_change: Insert a provenance-erasing executable handoff: an upstream constructor emits one complete policy, while the final authority receives that executable artifact and the common external inputs but none of the upstream rationale, deltas, provisional states, or retained evidence.
qualitative_hypothesis.expected_effect: Independent whole-artifact reconciliation should jointly improve phase-transition response coherence and scan-disturbance containment without sacrificing executable lineage visibility.

qualitative_hypothesis.observed_bottleneck: The active family assumes retained edit provenance remains causally useful through finalization, but that history can entrench anchor-relative decomposition and make terminal judgment depend on edit order rather than whole-artifact coherence.

structural_mutation.after: A two-call executable lineage crosses a policy-only handoff that withholds all predecessor provenance while transferring whole-artifact reconciliation authority to the final call.
structural_mutation.before: One producer retains raw evidence and reversible anchor-relative deltas through terminal remove-and-replay compression.
structural_mutation.why_structural: The mutation changes edge visibility and state-transition semantics: final authority acts on an executable whole without inheriting the construction history that previously governed rollback and compression.
